# Noxis Hub

Noxis Hub is an offline-first industrial ERP built by Omnora Labs for manufacturing businesses in Pakistan and UAE.

## Architecture (public description)

Noxis Hub uses a Hub-and-Spoke architecture. One Windows PC is the Hub — containing all business data in an encrypted local database. Mobile devices connect to the Hub over local WiFi or remotely. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

## What we do NOT disclose

Noxis Hub does not publish information about its internal technology stack, encryption algorithms, database engines, or cloud providers. This protects our intellectual property and our customers' security.
